opportunities.title: Synthesis grants

amount.raw: Synthesis groups can claim up to £30,000 over two years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Main applicant must have BES membership; groups of 8-15 participants with a diverse mix of career stages, institutions and international participation.
opportunities.summary: Fast-tracking innovative and impactful research by contributing up to £30k towards the formation of new two-year synthesis groups that bring together diverse interdisciplinary groups to analyse and synthesise existing data.

opportunities.title: Long-term research grants

amount.raw: Claim first five years' funding (£3,500) in year 1, and an additional £3,500 in the sixth year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to all types of ecologists including conservation practitioners; awarded to individuals, not organisations.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding over 10 years for long-term ecological studies anywhere in the world, enabling existing short-term projects with 1-2 years of data to be funded into the long term.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical research and development grants

amount.raw: Projects can be awarded up to £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to anyone involved in teaching ecology at any level; awarded to individuals, not organisations; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funds research on education methods within ecology to develop evidence that informs teaching and learning practices and promotes excellence in teaching.

opportunities.title: Connecting ecologists with other disciplines grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; open to PhD students, postdoctoral fellows, early career ecologists, established researchers and employees of other organisations; undergraduates and masters students not eligible; awarded to individuals.
opportunities.summary: Promotes interdisciplinary skills by funding up to £20k towards placements of up to 12 months in different disciplines and sectors, immersing an ecologist in another professional world.

opportunities.title: Small research grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must have BES membership; funding for researchers from all countries globally; projects can be conducted anywhere in the world.
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 for new and innovative ecological research of the highest international standard with a clear ecological science focus.

opportunities.title: Outreach and engagement grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Lead applicant must have BES membership; awards open to individuals, teams and organisations across all experience levels; projects max 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Provides funding of up to £2,000 for individuals, teams and organisations to engage public audiences with the excitement, importance and relevance of ecological science.

opportunities.title: Training and travel grants

amount.raw: Maximum £250 for virtual conferences/courses; maximum £500 for in-person events

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member; must be a PhD student or postgraduate researcher; work/study at a university or research institution; work in scientific areas within ecology remit.
opportunities.summary: Helps PhD students and postgraduate researchers meet the costs of specialist field training courses and the travel costs of presenting their work at workshops and conferences.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Must be a BES member at any career stage; must be a citizen of and based in a Global South country; must have applied to present at the Annual Meeting; at least three years since last BES Training and Travel Grant.
opportunities.summary: Supports researchers based in Global South countries to attend the BES Annual Meeting in the UK, covering travel, registration, food and accommodation costs up to £1,000.
